selected_provenance.basis: Exact selected corrected nine-file source manifest and retained head source/object/control-relink provenance, not current ownfork HEAD. Three model/header/main hashes freshly match source-correction. Config c43 freshly read. No physical host observation in this review.

enabled_fact.config: Exact c43 args omit --no-expert-cache; env contains no DS4_CACHE/DS4_RECENT override. Action-time actual argv and full relevant inherited environment must still be checked. DS4_STREAM=0 is not expert_cache=false.
enabled_fact.conclusion: Enabling the existing adaptive cache again would be a no-op.

selected_mechanism: Model1198-1222/3306-3320: asynchronous worker queue with default four workers on multiple GPUs, at most eight in-flight swaps. Defaults margin1.25, bonus1, decay0.9 per accumulated256 processed tokens. Not a fixed background slow timer.
Model5003/7935/11991: profile seeds heat; routed expert work updates heat. Work counters may include speculative/verification work and are not interchangeable with accepted generated tokens.

Model7179-7240 GGUF swap_in_mx: copy_mode reads the incoming expert from its RAM copy, uploads to spare VRAM and copies outgoing expert into spare RAM; device work is ordered by copy_open/copy_after_idle. cache_switch7255-7353 switches mappings between windows; cache_drain waits before chunks borrow tails.

Model2525 sets file_experts=true for GGUF even when all CPU experts are copied to RAM. Default recent_n32 condition chunk>0&&!file_experts is false for this selected GGUF, so recent slots default0, absent explicit override.

Model4972: disabling expert_cache removes one spare VRAM slot per eligible mixed layer; recent-slot reservation would also change if separately enabled. Model4005/10521: profile source and prompt-path selection also change; fixed forces flow. This is one configuration policy factor, not isolated transfer-only arithmetic.

Model12103 save_profile persists accumulated routing counts after serve requests. Each arm must receive a byte-identical immutable seed copied into an owned arm directory; no arm may write the production profile or inherit the preceding arm learned profile.

Prompt/KV reuse and expert-residency adaptation are distinct caches. Weight identities are intended to remain the same, but CPU/GPU and prompt path arithmetic can differ; no exact sampled-token or full-logit equivalence claim is justified by this toggle.

observability.native_DONE: Exact generated count, prompt/decode ms, finish, drafts accepted/offered, reused prompt count and raw decode hits/lookups. DONE hit numerator is experts minus CPU experts; STAT vram_hit also subtracts stream experts. Preserve definitions and verify stream0 actual behavior.
observability.native_STAT: promo is swap delta/internal fed tokens rounded3 decimals; vram_hit rounded4; cpu/ram experts per internal token and placement tiers. Retain raw STAT sequence and actual native trace ownership, never infer exact integer swaps from rounded promo.
observability.INFO: Context/KV resident, expert slots/CPU experts/RAM experts and engine identity; not migration-byte counters.
observability.not_available: No exact per-request H2D/D2H migration bytes or complete exact swap count in existing serve DONE/STAT. disk_mb is process storage I/O, not PCIe bytes; total expert bytes times rounded promo is not a measured byte counter.
observability.optional_debug: DS4_CPU_STATS adds cumulative recent-fill/CPU phase statistics. DS4_CHECK_SWAPS logs role-byte matches or MISMATCH and adds file reads/device copies; MISMATCH is not itself a process failure. Neither should be silently enabled in timing. A separate correctness diagnostic, if required, must fail closed on mismatch and cannot substitute for output/lifecycle checks.

current_upstream.findings: Current upstream also defaults expert_cache=true. Release advertises long-prompt improvements, with decode unchanged in its aggregate comparison. Selected dfe lacks link_h2d and ring_slots; the newer link-probe regression/fix cannot be claimed as a gain over selected92. Newer model source is much broader than this factor and must not be deployed wholesale as cache enablement.
current_upstream.mbelli: Parent public identity/repository search remains separate. Do not equate Discord Mbelli with SeriousRising or an unrelated GitHub username. No independently verified Mbelli S2/cache implementation is available to this review; this is not a universal absence claim.

excluded_candidate.meaning: DS4_CACHE_REUSE_MIB is a previous Oct27 shared-Q5/cache-migration bundle in ownfork, absent selected. Not a new adaptive-cache enablement and not included in proposed test; historical held/closed evidence remains unchanged.

minimal_proposal.factor: Current adaptive default vs selected92 plus sole --no-expert-cache argument. Same binary, complete model/DSpark/vision/projection/context/output/settings. Separate new adaptive-cache namespace and arms; neither is a Maya-S replay.
minimal_proposal.design: Freeze two separately admitted policy windows using identical immutable profile seed, isolated writable profile/cache/slot/lane/lt directories, fixed identical request order. Initial current-adaptive arm and fixed-policy control; no automatic repeat or reversed confirmation. If either is partial, preserve failure and do not declare a completed comparison.
minimal_proposal.panel: Smallest useful combined screen can retain the four existing full-cap known-answer states (cold, warm, two images, return), one unchanged natural expository prose task, and exact typed-tool/followup plus confirmed-prefill-cancel/recovery. This is nine requests, no dumps, no output fitting, all cap32768/effort100 within1M/262144 allowance. Reuse literal work under new family IDs; freeze expected prefix/slot behavior and source-backed encodings before execution. If implementers choose separate quality and timing windows instead, freeze that plan before data, not after a timeout.
minimal_proposal.budget: 800startup/1000soft from before load/1200wall/200cleanup unchanged; root132start/120runtime, swapoutdelta<1GiB, cache8GiB/log4GiB. Keep qualified private80GiB fence and actual post-stop>=88GiB gate if reusing current lifecycle. Existing selected-pack seven-request phase571.5s is a planning observation only, not proof nine natural requests will finish; preserve90s prefill-cancel admission and all partials.
minimal_proposal.correctness: Both policy configurations need newly source-qualified config/owner/fixture/auditor controls on Mac and physical Ubuntu. Require native/API/transport identity and counts, correct typed four states, prose manual compliance, full tool/cancel/recovery, cold/warm reuse, no length/cap/error, complete source-aligned metrics, resource/fence cleanup and selected default restoration. Same weights does not establish full numerical equivalence across CPU/GPU scheduling.
minimal_proposal.measurement: Compare natural-main native decode rate and cold prefill, preserve generated/reasoning/visible length, client time, draft, raw hit/lookup, promo and actual placement. No hit-rate-maximization criterion and no task-speed claim for unequal output work. Positive promo is evidence of migration in that observed interval; zero rounded promo is not proof the feature is disabled.
minimal_proposal.pre_actions: Pause Unsloth cooperatively and verify actual exit/absence before private action; fresh actual selected source/config/env/owner/idle/default/phase/root/previous-window guard. No staging/heavy CPU until genuine idle. Every new source/test manual Root+same reviewer and exact both-host bounded proofs precede separate action-time admission.
minimal_proposal.scope: No model/quant/TP/chunk/Q8/effort/output change, no cache pruning/global VM/driver/power changes, no old held candidate, no automatic promotion.

limitations: Source-based readiness only; no new CPU/model/benchmark performed.
Current binding and download worker are parent-reported snapshots, not refreshed by reviewer.
No exact PCIe-copy-byte accounting is available from the existing serve protocol.
No full upstream integration assessment or Mbelli identity assertion.
